meta.title: Alex Chan - Senior Product Manager, Payments

header.name: Alex Chan
header.headline: Senior Product Manager | Payments & B2B Fintech

sections.title: Professional Summary
sections.text: Senior product manager with 7 years in payments, B2B fintech and e-commerce. Owns product roadmaps end to end, from customer discovery and SQL-based analysis to A/B testing and launch, and works closely with Compliance and Risk on regulated features such as KYC.

bullets.text: Own the payments product roadmap, defining KPIs and SQL/Looker dashboards that guided a 38% increase in monthly active merchants in 12 months.
Led a cross-functional Agile squad of 9 engineers and 2 designers to rebuild merchant onboarding, cutting average onboarding time from 5 days to 1 day.
Ran 20+ A/B tests on the payments API developer portal, lifting developer sign-up conversion by 12%.
Managed stakeholders across Compliance and Risk to ship KYC checks aligned with HKMA guidance without slipping the quarterly roadmap.
Owned the seller dashboard product roadmap for 15,000 SME merchants, prioritising features through customer interviews and usage data.
Launched a bilingual (Traditional Chinese and English) seller app, raising weekly active sellers by 22%.
Introduced quarterly OKRs and a lightweight PRD template that 4 product teams adopted.
Gathered requirements from 6 business units and wrote user stories for a mobile banking release used by more than 1 million customers.
Automated weekly management reporting with Python, saving 6 analyst hours per week.

entries.heading: Bachelor of Business Administration, Information Systems

items.text: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Scrum Alliance, 2021
